applicability.scope: Source-grounded audit of native image-generation weight/runtime residency and optional segment prefetch; confirm the actual source, GGML, backend, model and executing path independently.

limitations: Source-derived candidate; native inference, allocator behavior, image quality and performance were not run.
Nineteen selected readset files match the pinned Git commit/tree blob IDs and sizes; this does not authenticate every archive member or submodule contents.
GGML and other submodules are not expanded; matching private GGML headers are required even for a system library.
CPU bypasses the inspected accelerator capacity gate and segmentation eligibility, so CPU checks cannot qualify accelerator memory budgets or prefetch.
Video/audio pipelines, detailed model kernels, approximate denoising caches and full multi-device execution remain outside this readset.
